# Agents and MCP

Give an AI agent, or any tool that reads API descriptions, access to your organization's data. Both routes go through the [public API](/docs/build/public-api), so the agent acts with an API key and can never do more than the key's owner.

- [Connect an agent through MCP](/docs/build/agents-and-mcp/connect-an-agent-through-mcp): add Monark's tools to Claude Desktop, Cursor or another MCP host.
- [Use the OpenAPI spec](/docs/build/agents-and-mcp/use-the-openapi-spec): generate a client or tool definitions from the machine-readable description.
